newsitem.title: USA: Calif. court funding plan clears Assembly-paper.
newsitem.headline: Calif. court funding plan clears Assembly-paper.

text.p: California's Assembly approved a plan to shift more responsibility for funding state trial courts from cash-strapped counties to the state, according to a published report on Tuesday.

Large counties would cap their contributions to trial courts at 1994-1995 levels. The state would assume responsibility for funding trial courts in the 20 smallest counties, the Sacramento Bee newspaper reported.
The Assembly approved the measure, Assembly Bill 233, on a bipartisan vote. The bill now advances to the state Senate.
